data.reason: Review findings F1, F3 and F4. F1: a well-formed Jev reply missing one answer key raises out of _ask_api, so ask_batch's HarnessError re-raise destroys the whole triage rather than recording that one absence, and with no triage record the review gate then accepts any read list at all. F3: criterion 5 names kpi.json, and delivery is the only writer of it and calls kpi.measure without reviewer_tokens, so the figure could never land there. F4: the focus set is a floor over the read list but nothing re-checks the diff at the review advance, so a file added after the triage is read by nobody and refused by nothing. F2 and F5 are resolved without code and recorded in the review record.
